evals.prompt:
Here's my LinkedIn profile text, it's a bit of a mess. I want Platform Engineer roles. Can you sort it out?

Headline: Cloud Ninja | Tech Enthusiast | Problem Solver
About: Results-driven professional with a proven track record of delivering scalable solutions. Passionate about technology and always eager to learn.
Experience: Senior Engineer at Fintech Co, 2021-now. Worked on cloud stuff, reduced costs a lot. Built CI/CD. Managed Kubernetes clusters and wrote Terraform.
evals.expected_output: Positioning line, then headline/About/skills blocks with character counts within limits, keywords in skills and About tail but not driving the headline, [VALIDATE] on the unquantified cost claim

evals.prompt: I don't really have a LinkedIn profile yet beyond my name and job title. Here's my CV - can you build me one? I'm targeting SRE roles.
evals.expected_output: Cold start from CV: positioning pass, headline/About/skills, consistency between CV and new profile, no invented material

evals.prompt: Just fix my LinkedIn headline, it's rubbish: 'Experienced IT Professional | Open to Opportunities'
evals.expected_output: A usable headline quickly, without a long positioning interrogation; asks at most one question and delivers a candidate headline with its character count
